package courseclient

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

func TestGetTaskPreservesTrustedStructuredAssessmentKeys(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/internal/task/get-internal-task/task-id" {
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
			return
		}
		if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "trusted-token" {
			http.Error(responseWriter, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
			return
		}
		responseWriter.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(responseWriter).Encode(map[string]any{
			"id":        "task-id",
			"lesson_id": "lesson-id",
			"course_id": "course-id",
			"status":    1,
			"type":      13,
			"task_kind": "classification",
			"learning_targets": []any{
				map[string]any{"type": "capability", "key": "learning.semantic-sequence", "version": "v1"},
				map[string]any{"type": "concept", "key": "program.instructions.sequence"},
			},
			"tests": []any{
				map[string]any{
					"id": "question-id", "kind": "classification", "title": "Classify", "order": 1,
					"groups": []any{
						map[string]any{"id": "group-id", "title": "Group", "order": 1},
					},
					"variants": []any{
						map[string]any{
							"id": "variant-id", "text": "Item", "order": 1,
							"is_correct": true, "correct_order": 2,
							"group_id": "group-id", "group_source_key": "group-key",
						},
					},
				},
			},
		})
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	task, err := (Client{
		BaseURL:       server.URL,
		InternalToken: "trusted-token",
		HTTPClient:    server.Client(),
	}).GetTask(context.Background(), "task-id")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get task: %v", err)
	}
	if len(task.Tests) != 1 || task.Tests[0].Kind != "classification" || len(task.Tests[0].Groups) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("structured assessment metadata missing: %+v", task.Tests)
	}
	if len(task.LearningTargets) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("learning target metadata missing: %+v", task.LearningTargets)
	}
	if task.LearningTargets[0].Type != domain.LearningTargetCapability || task.LearningTargets[0].Key != "learning.semantic-sequence" || task.LearningTargets[0].Version != "v1" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first learning target: %+v", task.LearningTargets[0])
	}
	variant := task.Tests[0].Variants[0]
	if !variant.IsCorrect || variant.CorrectOrder == nil || *variant.CorrectOrder != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("trusted correctness metadata missing: %+v", variant)
	}
	if variant.GroupID != "group-id" || variant.GroupSourceKey != "group-key" {
		t.Fatalf("trusted classification assignment missing: %+v", variant)
	}
}

func TestGetTaskRejectsInvalidLearningTargets(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		responseWriter.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_ = json.NewEncoder(responseWriter).Encode(map[string]any{
			"id": "task-id",
			"learning_targets": []any{
				map[string]any{"type": "mastery", "key": "learning.semantic-sequence"},
			},
		})
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	if _, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetTask(context.Background(), "task-id"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid learning target error")
	}
}

func TestGetTaskChecksAndCachesPublicRelationAccess(t *testing.T) {
	const relationID = "7f8b2498-4666-4ff2-8527-b5991199ca22"
	publicCalls := 0
	internalCalls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		switch request.URL.Path {
		case "/api/v1/task/get/task-id":
			publicCalls++
			if request.URL.Query().Get("fields") != "id" || request.URL.Query().Get("via_relation_id") != relationID {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected public access query: %s", request.URL.RawQuery)
			}
			if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "" {
				t.Fatal("public access check must not use the internal token")
			}
			if request.Header.Get("X-User-ID") != "student-id" || request.Header.Get("X-User-Role") != "STUDENT_PRO" {
				t.Fatalf("public access check is missing audience headers: %v", request.Header)
			}
			responseWriter.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = responseWriter.Write([]byte(`{"id":"task-id"}`))
		case "/internal/task/get-internal-task/task-id":
			internalCalls++
			if request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "trusted-token" {
				t.Fatal("trusted metadata request is missing its internal token")
			}
			responseWriter.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			_, _ = responseWriter.Write([]byte(`{"id":"task-id","lesson_id":"lesson-id","course_id":"course-id","status":1}`))
		default:
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "trusted-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	ctx := answer.WithPublicContentAccessAudience(context.Background(), relationID, "student-id", "student_pro")
	for range 2 {
		if _, err := client.GetTask(ctx, "task-id"); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("get task: %v", err)
		}
	}
	if publicCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one cached public preflight, got %d", publicCalls)
	}
	if internalCalls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected two trusted metadata reads, got %d", internalCalls)
	}
}

func TestGetTaskRejectsHiddenDirectAccessBeforeTrustedMetadataRead(t *testing.T) {
	internalCalls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path == "/api/v1/task/get/task-id" {
			if request.URL.Query().Get("via_relation_id") != "" {
				t.Fatal("direct access unexpectedly included a relation")
			}
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
			return
		}
		internalCalls++
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unexpected trusted read", http.StatusInternalServerError)
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	_, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "trusted-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}).GetTask(
		answer.WithPublicContentAccess(context.Background(), ""),
		"task-id",
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("expected not found, got %v", err)
	}
	if internalCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("hidden task reached trusted metadata endpoint %d times", internalCalls)
	}
}

func TestGetTaskAllowsHiddenCourseWhenStudentHasAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	internalCalls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		switch request.URL.Path {
		case "/api/v1/task/get/task-id":
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		case "/internal/task/get-internal-task/task-id":
			internalCalls++
			_ = json.NewEncoder(responseWriter).Encode(map[string]any{
				"id": "task-id", "lesson_id": "lesson-id", "course_id": "private-course-id", "status": 1,
			})
		default:
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	access := &assignedCourseAccessStub{allowed: true}
	client := Client{
		BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "trusted-token", HTTPClient: server.Client(), AssignmentAccess: access,
	}
	ctx := answer.WithPublicContentAccessAudience(context.Background(), "", "student-id", "STUDENT")
	task, err := client.GetTask(ctx, "task-id")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get assigned private task: %v", err)
	}
	if task.CourseID != "private-course-id" || internalCalls != 1 || access.studentID != "student-id" ||
		access.courseID != "private-course-id" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected assigned access: task=%+v calls=%d access=%+v", task, internalCalls, access)
	}
}

func TestGetCourseStructureAllowsHiddenCourseWhenStudentHasAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	internalCalls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		switch request.URL.Path {
		case "/api/v1/course/get/private-course-id":
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		case "/internal/course/get-internal-course-structure/private-course-id":
			internalCalls++
			_ = json.NewEncoder(responseWriter).Encode(map[string]any{
				"course_id": "private-course-id",
				"lessons":   []map[string]any{{"id": "lesson-id", "course_id": "private-course-id", "status": 1}},
			})
		default:
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	access := &assignedCourseAccessStub{allowed: true}
	client := Client{
		BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "trusted-token", HTTPClient: server.Client(), AssignmentAccess: access,
	}
	ctx := answer.WithPublicContentAccessAudience(context.Background(), "", "student-id", "STUDENT")
	structure, err := client.GetCourseStructure(ctx, "private-course-id")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get assigned private course: %v", err)
	}
	if structure.CourseID != "private-course-id" || len(structure.Lessons) != 1 || internalCalls != 1 ||
		access.studentID != "student-id" || access.courseID != "private-course-id" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected assigned access: structure=%+v calls=%d access=%+v", structure, internalCalls, access)
	}
}

func TestGetTaskRejectsHiddenCourseWhenStudentHasNoAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		switch request.URL.Path {
		case "/api/v1/task/get/task-id":
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		case "/internal/task/get-internal-task/task-id":
			_ = json.NewEncoder(responseWriter).Encode(map[string]any{
				"id": "task-id", "lesson_id": "lesson-id", "course_id": "private-course-id", "status": 1,
			})
		default:
			http.NotFound(responseWriter, request)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	access := &assignedCourseAccessStub{allowed: false}
	client := Client{
		BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "trusted-token", HTTPClient: server.Client(), AssignmentAccess: access,
	}
	ctx := answer.WithPublicContentAccessAudience(context.Background(), "", "student-id", "STUDENT")
	if _, err := client.GetTask(ctx, "task-id"); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("unassigned hidden task: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPublicAccessPreflightUsesResourceSpecificRoutes(t *testing.T) {
	paths := make([]string, 0, 3)
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		paths = append(paths, request.URL.Path)
		responseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	for _, item := range []struct {
		kind string
		id   string
	}{
		{kind: "course", id: "course-id"},
		{kind: "lesson", id: "lesson-id"},
		{kind: "task", id: "task-id"},
	} {
		ctx := answer.WithPublicContentAccess(context.Background(), "")
		if err := client.requirePublicAccess(ctx, item.kind, item.id); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("preflight %s: %v", item.kind, err)
		}
	}

	want := []string{
		"/api/v1/course/get/course-id",
		"/api/v1/lesson/get/lesson-id",
		"/api/v1/task/get/task-id",
	}
	if len(paths) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected preflight paths: %v", paths)
	}
	for index := range want {
		if paths[index] != want[index] {
			t.Fatalf("preflight path %d: got %q want %q", index, paths[index], want[index])
		}
	}
}

type assignedCourseAccessStub struct {
	allowed             bool
	studentID, courseID string
	err                 error
}

func (stub *assignedCourseAccessStub) CanAccessCourse(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	courseID string,
) (bool, error) {
	stub.studentID, stub.courseID = studentID, courseID
	return stub.allowed, stub.err
}
